summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for rebranding and rebuilding the game as Tangier City: Mesnana Golf (v1.3.0), featuring the official Tangier Mediterranean Sea Blue palette, TV-clear typography with a Text Size setting, context-tabbed full controller/keyboard mapping (In Car, On Foot, Menus & UI), an authentic connected road network and satellite-style World Map of Tangier - Mesnana Golf & Kawassim neighbors, a Unified Command Hub with dedicated World Map and Missions screens, a top compass arrow + rotating route mini-map, and key physics/UX fixes.
